parsed.explanation: No documented traveler-facing criminalisation, border/document hostility, or facility exclusion, though border screening, marker handling, and facility access remain unresolved open questions. Gender-identity discrimination is a criminal offence and equality law covers services, health and education; conversion practices were prosecuted as assault. Broad Pride participation and legal reforms indicate substantial social acceptance. Resident gaps in legal recognition and care access are climate signals, not visitor exposures. Hate-crime counts are reported suspicions without denominators and are not trans-specific, so they do not establish organised targeting. Strong acceptance and institutional protections support a low-risk assessment, but unverified visitor-facing border and facility practice keeps the score near the low-risk threshold rather than at high-confidence safety.
